title: CmdPal: Apps (0): Prerequisites (1) - Fix provider command publication

review.body_prefix:
### Qualified current-revision assessment

The provider-load changes were traced through registration, deferred/coalesced reloads, initial publication, timeout continuation and removal. The ordinary-load completion loop remains necessary: the separate continuation is started only for timed-out loads, so those paths do not complete the same load twice. The duplicated test notifications deliberately exercise coalescing.

No additional actionable correctness defect was established in this revision. Renaming unused event arguments and adding explanatory test comments are optional style/readability preferences rather than required behavior corrections.

**Validation scope:** The complete changed source/tests and actual caller relationships were reviewed. The exact x64 Debug view-model test project built with analyzers enabled, and all 21 selected provider-manager/cache tests passed. No complete product build, live extension-provider churn or interactive UI run is claimed. This is a qualified assessment, not an unconditional approval.
